groups.kind: What sort of work it is. Usually one per issue.
groups.priority: How soon it matters relative to the next release.
groups.parked: Recorded for later; not part of the current plan.
groups.status: Where the work is right now. An open issue with no status label is ready.
groups.layer: Optional. Which Clean Architecture layer a change belongs to.

labels.name: chore
labels.description: Small routine change: text, graphics, posters, housekeeping

labels.name: performance
labels.description: Code change aimed at making something faster or lighter

labels.name: maintenance
labels.description: Code quality: refactoring, tests, internal maintainability

labels.name: p1
labels.description: Must be fixed before the next release

labels.name: p2
labels.description: Should be in the next release, but not blocking it

labels.name: p3
labels.description: Nice to have; fine to skip

labels.name: not-urgent
labels.description: Parked idea: worth doing eventually, not something to pick up now

labels.name: in review
labels.description: A pull request is open and waiting for review

labels.name: to verify
labels.description: Merged. Waiting for you to confirm it works, then close

labels.name: blocked
labels.description: Cannot proceed; the reason is in the comments

labels.name: layer:data
labels.description: Repository implementations, data sources, API and storage access
